title:
Every cup begins
as a fruit.
description: Before coffee is a bean, it is a cherry on a tree.

title:
Harvested
at ripeness
description: The ripe cherry protects the coffee seeds within.

title:
Honey
process
description: Soft fruit skin is removed; mucilage remains on the seeds during drying.

title:
Washed
process
description: Water carries the mucilage away, exposing the parchment-covered coffee seeds.

title:
Natural
process
description: The whole cherry dries; its outer husk is removed to reveal parchment-covered seeds.

title:
Removing the
parchment
description: Dry, brittle parchment breaks into flakes to reveal green coffee.

title:
Selected.
Sorted. Graded.
description: Green coffee is prepared to an agreed buyer specification.

title:
Character,
developed by heat.
description: The same bean deepens from green to a rich roasted brown.

title:
Ground
for the brew
description: Roasted coffee is ground to suit the intended brewing method.

title:
From origin
to the cup.
description: Green coffee. Roasted coffee. Filter coffee.
